Operation.dc.html.title: Campaign — Operations Iron Tide & Black Meridian (live save)

heading.text: Gunline — capital ship squadron battle mockup

howto.text: New here? Press Play on the battle board: a short guided battle (How to play, top right) walks you through plotting, orders, committing and rolling. Campaign: on the Operation board (right) pick an available mission, press Ready the fleet, then Launch. The battle board loads your saved ships with their damage, crew, criticals, refits, captains and veterancy, plus the mission's enemies, terrain and objectives. The debrief writes losses, prizes, credits and renown back; repair, refit and buy new hulls at drydocks. Finishing Iron Tide opens Operation Black Meridian. Controls: click in the blue fan to plot, pick an order, double-click (or double-tap) to plot and move on; Backspace clears a course, Enter commits, R replays the last turn. The preview panel shows damage dealt and taken plus threats: torpedo lanes, tractor and ram reach, boarding risk.
